title: How to Cancel Verizon Fios Internet: Equipment Return and Fees (2026)
description: How to cancel Verizon Fios internet: you must contact Verizon to start a disconnect, return rented equipment within 30 days, and what unreturned equipment can cost. Checked November 27, 2026.
h1: How to cancel Verizon Fios internet
lead: What Verizon says about disconnecting Fios and returning equipment, and the fees to check first.
short_answer: Verizon says you must contact it to start a Fios disconnect and equipment return. Rented equipment must come back within 30 days of the disconnect date, or Verizon lists an unreturned equipment fee of up to $375 per item. Per-item charges on its page include $175 for a Fios Router (G3100) and $100 for a Fios Quantum Gateway (G1100).

sections.body_html: Check your latest Fios bill for a price lock or promotional end date and for any equipment you rent. If the reason is a higher bill, read why your Fios bill went up first. We could not read Verizon's own cancellation page in this check, so we do not state a cancellation fee or phone route for Fios. Ask Verizon for the exact fee, if any, on your account before you confirm a date.

Verizon's equipment return page says: contact Verizon to initiate your disconnect and return. We suggest My Verizon or the number printed on your bill. Then:

  1. Ask for your disconnect date and the final bill amount, and whether any fee applies on your account.
  2. Ask Verizon to list every piece of rented equipment on the account (router, extenders, set-top boxes).
  3. Write down the agent's name, the date and the confirmation details.
  4. Line up your next provider's install date so you are not without service.

Verizon says to return rented equipment within 30 days of the service disconnection date to avoid an unreturned equipment fee, which it lists at up to $375 for each piece of equipment. Examples from its table:

sections.body_html:
Verizon says to bring unboxed equipment and the power cord to a The UPS Store, which scans serial numbers and ships it; keep the receipt. Verizon also says residents of DC, DE, MD, MA, NJ, NY, PA, RI and VA can drop equipment at a Verizon store. If you lost your return kit or label, Verizon says you do not need to call: take the equipment to a The UPS Store. Verizon says credits can take up to 2 bill cycles after the return is complete and to contact it if you have no refund within 3 bill cycles.
